findings.detail: X08 flags a 23.7 million cost row as fair value below 5% of cost, but the raw schedule row with 23.7 amortized cost reports 19.5 million fair value.

rationale: Class 2 row-validation review. The bundle reports four X08 low fair-value/cost warnings. Targeted source checks found source-supported distressed equity rows for the 29.4/0.1 ADG Class A common-units row, a 5.1/0.1 preferred-units row, and a 7.7/0.2 preferred-units row. The 23.7 million cost item is contradicted by the raw schedule: the matching current-period row reports 23.7 million amortized cost and 19.5 million fair value, well above the 5% threshold. That indicates a stored fair-value/value-field defect rather than a valid distressed-position warning.
